title: Copyright Information
content:
Copyright Information
Thanks for visiting the site! OBD-Codes.com is one of, if not the most popular trouble code car repair web site on the planet :-)
We know that the information on the site is in high demand. Who doesn't want to save money on car repairs!? We like to help people but when our information is pasted all over the 'net without giving us credit, well that's just not nice. We have have been building the site since 2004, so countless time and money invested in the site and when you simply "steal" the content it's disrespectful.
Why should I link to your article instead of just copying and pasting the information elsewhere?
Good question! We see our content copied and scattered about on various sites on the 'net. Ranging from car forums to sites that charge you to ask a question, we've seen our content all over the place. Really there are two reasons why you should always link to our articles:
- If we update an article, it is updated automatically on our site. If you copy-and-paste the article on site EXAMPLE.com then if we update the article with other relevant information the information you just posted is out-dated.
- The information contained on the site is protected by international copyright laws. That means it's not OK to simply copy and paste an article from here on another web site. Although we can't really stop you from copying the information, we do proactively monitor for copyright infringements and go after those web sites containing the information.
Thanks for your understanding. If you have any comments or questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.
NOTE: This information is presented for information purposes only. It is not intended as repair advice and we are not responsible for any actions you take on any vehicle. All information on this site is copyright protected.
